name: evitania-manager
description: Gerenciador de produção e coleta para Evitania
author: João Neto

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run icons && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/clean-release.mjs linux && npm run build && npm run validate:package && electron-builder --linux deb --publish never --config.directories.output=release/linux/build && node scripts/package-platform.mjs --platform linux && node scripts/inspect-native.mjs --platform linux --artifact release/linux/publish/Evitania-Manager-${npm_package_version}-amd64.deb --version ${npm_package_version}
scripts.dist:windows: node scripts/clean-release.mjs windows && npm run build && npm run validate:package && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never --config.directories.output=release/windows/build && node scripts/package-platform.mjs --platform windows && node scripts/inspect-native.mjs --platform windows --artifact release/windows/publish/Evitania-Manager-%npm_package_version%-x64.exe --executable "release/windows/build/win-unpacked/Evitania Manager.exe" --version %npm_package_version%

linux.synopsis: Gerenciador de produção e coleta para Evitania
linux.description: Gerenciador de produção e coleta para Evitania

entry.Name: Evitania Manager
entry.Comment: Gerenciador de produção e coleta para Evitania
